landmarks.name: Ancient Dragon Hoard
landmarks.lore:
"Gazing up at the remnants of what once was a majestic hoard, one cannot help but contemplate the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept]Dragon[/hyperlink] that fell here, and its destructive rivalry with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept]Giants[/hyperlink]. See how even the bones seem to still protect its treasures. As the wind howled through the peaks, I swear I could hear the dragon's ancient roar still..."

— Fangir Rockborne, Journals from the Second Age: Part II

enchantments.description: All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRAGON]Dragon[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FRENZY]Frenzy[/hyperlink] until the end of combat.

landmarks.name: Broken Wizard's Throne
landmarks.lore:
"Imagine the masters of strongly opposing magics all gathered within a single tower. They may hate each other to oblivion, but they have learned to respect that every affinity must seep through a world for it to be in equilibrium. The Wizard's Throne is the ultimate guarantor of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept]Circle of Deogai's[/hyperlink] balance. For it reminds all Wizards of their own diminutiveness within the vast schemes of the cosmos."

— Gabriel, Chronicles of Evermore

landmarks.name: Cascade Falls
landmarks.lore:
"When the crown weighed heavily upon my mother, she would turn to the sanctuary of the falls. She said the cascade drowns out all chaos. In my search for her I, too, visit this place of peace. I wade into the stream, I let the torrent wash over me, and in its relentless rhythm I rediscover clarity and strength."

— Sundren of House Inioch, Memories of the Elven Court

landmarks.name: Chained Hellion
landmarks.lore:
"I can hear them screaming; beasts of chaos incarnated, subdued and bound in chains. They howl in rage and pain, swearing to destroy those who confined them. They tell their story again and again, so they never forget the hatred that keeps them alive. Oh... how I wish I could hunt them again."

— Demonic Prince Karavar, The Hellion Wars.

landmarks.name: Fountain of Creation
landmarks.lore:
"Like the geysers of lustral water we must sanctify the earth and tend it with providential care. By this truth, we erect fountains upon these torrents and thus, by understanding the labor of His work, we draw closer to the Allfather. For what are these streams, if not the incarnation of the Well of Creation made manifest?"

— Anon Archon Wizard of Life, On the Paths to Divine Ascent

landmarks.name: Grand Statuary
landmarks.lore:
"When I walk among these weathered statues, I ponder the souls they immortalize. Even those whose names are forgotten command my respect. Will I too, be remembered—or forgotten—like this? Will offerings grace my stone likeness, or will it be abandoned to time? Were my features carved into stone, would they become a beacon of hope—or of dread?"

— Alfred Elderstone, Musings on Rulership

landmarks.name: Haunted Battlefield
landmarks.lore:
"Do you feel it? Forbidden magic lingers on this battlefield... Not of creation, but of un-life. My kin tell the story of a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TraitorKingsLoreConcept]Traitor King[/hyperlink] who cursed the grounds with ancient magics where he fell... None who fought here shall ever know peace. And so, the souls of the fallen remain among their bones, forever fighting, forever dying..."

— Fjalla Tor-Builder, In the Giant's Footsteps: As cited by Ham Binger

enchantments.description:
Every [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], each corpse is resurrected as a random Skeleton unit with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink].

Skeleton units themselves are not resurrected by this effect, are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.NON_VITAL]Non-Vital[/hyperlink], and die at the end of combat.

landmarks.name: Icebound Behemoth
landmarks.lore:
"To gaze upon these vast, frozen eyes is to stand on the edge of eternity itself. Even sealed in frost, they pierce me—through flesh, soul, the very fabric of the cosmos. We, who claim mastery of the arcane, know nothing compared to this colossus of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrwildernessLoreConcept]Urwilderness[/hyperlink]. What are we to such an ageless, forgotten seer?"

— Merlin the Wanderer, recovered Journals from the Fourth Age

enchantments.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], every unit has a 90% of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REMORSE]Remorse[/hyperlink].

landmarks.name: Infernal Volcano
landmarks.lore:
"One need only witness what devastation volcanoes precipitate to understand its arcane potential... And mythical allure. Some propose these fiery chasms serve as portals to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept]Obbadoth[/hyperlink]. I have yet to confirm whether the fiends encountered here emerged from the molten heart itself, or if they have simply claimed it as their home."

— Larissa Mirabilis, Myth and Truth: Folklore and its Arcane Origins

landmarks.name: Leviathan Eyes
landmarks.lore:
"First, it brought the night. The light was eclipsed by its gargantuan shape, still veiled behind the overcast sky. Tentacles pierced the clouds, heralding the arrival of the beast. And then it fell. There was no sky—only the Leviathan. And its grotesque body, plunging like the end of all things."

— Sumuskira the Grovetender, Tales of the Elder: As cited by Reskar Scapeshaper

landmarks.name: Lithorine Peaks
landmarks.lore:
"Contrary to the 'cold' magic of the Focus Crystal, Lithorite emits a pulsating warmth. Perhaps this is why the ancient [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant Kings[/hyperlink] picked this material for the creation of Lithorine creatures. Even though those are fairly common, large clusters of the material itself are rare. When the sun catches the crystal peaks, it is truly a sight to behold."

— Edward Portsmith, Advanced Reports on Mana Infusion

landmarks.name: Mistflow Gardens
landmarks.lore:
"These mistflow gardens are places of communion for the Fey folk. Within them, the energy of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept]Duatha[/hyperlink] is vibrant, making them ideal ground for all manner of rituals. I myself was judged in one of them by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept]Duathadae[/hyperlink]. But what followed... is a story for another day."

— Ham Binger, Beyond the Mist of the Fey.

landmarks.name: Perishing Archnemesis
landmarks.lore:
Black banners billowed above [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept]The Carnage Bounds[/hyperlink].
Hellions held hard; their titan-lords roared.
Yet hosts of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]The Nether Prime[/hyperlink] came clawing skyward fiercely, while [hyperlink,GLOBAL.YsarielLoreConcept]The Future Throne[/hyperlink] broke gates and bulwark.
Thus Demon-kind surged forth; the elder breed perished.

—Liztia Great Skald of Pseumodius, Victory Poem of the Hellion Wars

enchantments.name: Scorching Stench of Suffering
enchantments.description:
All non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIEND]Fiend[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] suffer -5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink] and -2 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireResistanceConcept]Fire Protection[/hyperlink].
In addition, every [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]:All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] lose 5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] per stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink] they have.

landmarks.name: Subterranean Monuments
landmarks.lore:
"I see the fallen empire of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink] and my heart aches for what my kin have lost. Endless corridors and districts, sprawling through the Underground... How I grieve for Myrrida's Golden Age, its lost majesty carved into our history. But as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant King[/hyperlink] I must try and live up to its legacy..."

— Fjalla Tor-Builder, In the Giant's Footsteps: As cited by Ham Binger

landmarks.name: Thorn Heart
landmarks.lore:
"Following the blood rivers upstream, my Orcs found the literal heart of the Sunless Lands, beating within the trunk of a defiled World Tree. Soon after, they succumbed to the Blood Parasites, devoured from the inside. Some say the heart's infection is a curse from the ancient times, others call it the vile progeny of Vampiric cults. Me, I call it perfection."

— Karissa the Red, Blood Rites throughout the Ages
